name: Basel grid
lineage: Swiss International Style, Basel and Zurich schools, 1950s-70s
grammar: white surface with the grid exposed as hairlines · one neo-grotesque family at two weights · content locks to columns, one red element per viewport

name: Bauhaus catalog
lineage: Bauhaus Dessau exhibition catalogs and prospectuses, 1920s
grammar: warm off-white with primary-colour geometry · geometric sans, heavy lowercase · diagonal composition and rotated type earn their angle

name: Constructivist poster
lineage: Rodchenko and El Lissitzky poster work, 1920s
grammar: bone paper, red and black only · condensed caps set on the diagonal · photomontage crops and hard wedges direct the eye

name: Deco travel poster
lineage: Art Deco railway and ocean-liner posters, 1920s-30s
grammar: dusk gradients as flat bands, never mesh · tall geometric display caps with tight tracking · one monumental object dominates, small caption footer

name: NASA standards
lineage: NASA Graphics Standards Manual, Danne and Blackburn, 1975
grammar: cool white with one federal red accent · the worm logotype instinct, wide grotesque caps · specification pages: numbered figures, ruled captions

name: Bell manual
lineage: Saul Bass AT&T and Bell System identity standards, 1969-84
grammar: flat corporate blues on white · rounded geometric sans, generous sizes · systems diagrams with dot-and-line pictograms

name: Rams instruction card
lineage: Braun product literature under Dieter Rams, 1960s-70s
grammar: pale grey surface, colour only on the control being explained · small akzidenz-style labels, numbered · exploded product views with index lines

name: Olivetti showroom
lineage: Olivetti advertising and showroom graphics, Pintori era, 1950s
grammar: cream with playful primary confetti restrained to one zone · humanist sans with occasional script flourish · the machine drawn as a character, not photographed

name: Penguin grid
lineage: Penguin paperback covers, Tschichold and Marber grid, 1947-62
grammar: one flat band structure dividing the page by fixed ratio · serif title case, publisher-mark discipline · colour codes the category, band positions never move

name: Paste-up mechanical
lineage: Phototype and Letraset paste-up boards, 1970s studios
grammar: white board with visible crop marks and registration ticks · mixed display faces as physical specimens · elements sit slightly off-true, taped not templated

name: Riso zine
lineage: Risograph small-press printing, 1980s-now
grammar: uncoated paper, two soy-ink spot colours, visible misregistration · chunky bold sans, hand lettering allowed · overprint textures and halftone dots

name: Whole Earth spread
lineage: Whole Earth Catalog, 1968-74
grammar: newsprint cream, ink-dense · typewriter body with bold serif headers · dense multi-column item reviews with inline images and prices

name: Airline timetable
lineage: Mid-century airline timetables and route maps, 1950s-60s
grammar: white with one airline livery colour · tabular figures everywhere, tiny caps for city codes · the schedule table IS the layout, route arcs as decoration

name: Survey sheet
lineage: USGS topographic quadrangle sheets, 20th century
grammar: paper white with hairline contour density · small caps for place names, italic only for water · marginalia frame: datum notes, scale bars, sheet numbers

name: Naturalist plate
lineage: Audubon and 19th-century field-guide lithograph plates
grammar: warm ivory, one specimen centered · engraved serif captions with latin binomials · figure numbers and leader lines, plate framed by whitespace

name: Seed packet
lineage: American seed-packet lithography, 1900s-40s
grammar: saturated produce illustration on cream · ornamented display caps with banner ribbons · front-of-pack hierarchy: variety name, vignette, planting table on the back

name: Vitrine label
lineage: Museum object labels and vitrine cards
grammar: gallery white, ink only · one quiet serif at two sizes, generous leading · object number, title line, medium line, provenance paragraph

name: Transit wayfinding
lineage: Vignelli subway diagram and Calvert-Kinneir motorway signage, 1960s-70s
grammar: high-contrast panel colours with white reversal · one transport grotesque, mixed case, huge x-height · destination hierarchy: line, station, exit; arrows do the work

name: Teletext page
lineage: Ceefax and Minitel broadcast text services, 1970s-80s
grammar: true black with saturated RGB block colours · double-height bitmap caps · page numbers, block mosaics as graphics

name: Card catalog
lineage: Library card catalogs and microfiche archives
grammar: manila and buff cards, rubber-stamp red · typewriter mono with underline emphasis · drawer-and-card structure, tabbed dividers, call numbers

name: Double-entry ledger
lineage: Bookkeeping ledgers and banker's stationery, 19th-20th century
grammar: pale green or buff ruled paper · copperplate headers over mono figures · debit and credit columns, running balance, red for deficit only

name: Letterpress playbill
lineage: Broadside ballads and theatre playbills, 18th-19th century
grammar: cream rag paper, black ink, one spot red · a different wood-type face per line, all centered · stacked bill-of-fare hierarchy with rule dividers

name: Planetarium chart
lineage: Star atlases and planetarium programs, 19th-20th century
grammar: deep blue-black with pinpoint white and gold · classical serif with letterspaced small caps · constellation lines connect content nodes, coordinate ring frames

name: Concrete poem
lineage: Concrete poetry movement, Gomringer and the Noigandres group, 1950s-60s
grammar: bare page, ink only · one sans, one size, placement IS the meaning · words arranged as the thing they describe

name: Matchbook
lineage: American matchbook covers, 1930s-60s
grammar: one saturated ground colour, foil-adjacent accents · script wordmark over condensed caps address line · tiny canvas discipline: front hook, spine message, back offer

name: Classifieds page
lineage: Phone-book yellow pages and newspaper classifieds
grammar: yellow or newsprint ground, ink-dense · bold condensed headers over 6pt body · column rules, ad boxes of mixed sizes, alphabetical tabs

name: Line-printer output
lineage: Punched-card decks and tractor-feed line-printer reports, 1960s-70s
grammar: greenbar striped paper · uppercase mono only · fixed-width report blocks, page headers with job numbers

name: Catalog colophon
lineage: Exhibition-catalog colophons and fine-press back matter
grammar: warm white, ink, one metallic-adjacent accent · old-style serif with true small caps · edition numbering, typeface credits, paper stock notes as content

name: Matchbox label
lineage: Japanese matchbox labels, Meiji through Showa eras
grammar: flat two-ink illustration on kraft · hand-drawn logotype in a cartouche · one animal or object as the whole brand, border frames it

name: Pharma sachet
lineage: Geigy pharmaceutical packaging and literature, 1950s-60s
grammar: clinical white with one large abstract geometric figure · akzidenz-class grotesque, lowercase · dosage-table clarity, the abstract shape carries all emotion

name: Filmstrip frame
lineage: Mid-century instructional filmstrips and slide decks
grammar: warm kodachrome cast, rounded-corner frames · captioned lower-third bars · numbered frames advance the argument, sprocket rhythm as motif

name: Annual report modernism
lineage: Paul Rand and corporate annual reports, 1950s-70s
grammar: white with one witty die-cut-style graphic device · serif body, sans display, both restrained · full-page chart spreads treated as art plates

name: Isotype board
lineage: Otto Neurath's Isotype pictogram system, 1920s-40s
grammar: flat white, black, one signal red · pictogram rows where quantity = repetition, never scaling · captions beneath, unit legend at the foot

name: Nautical chart
lineage: Admiralty nautical charts, 19th-20th century
grammar: pale sea-tint with buff land · italic hydrographic labels, upright coastal caps · depth soundings as scattered numerals, compass rose earns its place

name: Recipe card
lineage: Mid-century boxed recipe cards
grammar: cream card with one gingham or tint band · friendly serif title, typewriter body · ingredients rail left, method numbered right, index-tab category

name: Racing livery
lineage: Motorsport liveries and roundel number plates, 1960s-70s
grammar: one team colour blocked against white, meatball roundel · italic-free condensed numerals, huge · sponsor-patch grid disciplined to the tail

name: Herbarium sheet
lineage: Botanical herbarium specimen sheets
grammar: aged white sheet, pressed-specimen centered · typed determinavit labels bottom-right · accession stamps and annotation slips accumulate as texture

name: Blueprint
lineage: Cyanotype architectural and engineering blueprints
grammar: prussian-blue ground with white line work · stencil-adjacent caps for title block · orthographic projections, dimension chains, revision table

name: Specimen broadsheet
lineage: Type-foundry specimen sheets, 19th century
grammar: cream broadsheet, ink only · every size of one family shown as content · waterfall settings and lorem-free showings, foundry footer

name: Observatory logbook
lineage: Scientific expedition and observatory logbooks
grammar: ivory ruled pages, iron-gall ink · cursive-adjacent serif for entries, upright for data · dated entries with sketches pasted in, marginal coordinates

name: Bus blind
lineage: London bus destination blinds and roller signs
grammar: black ground, white and yellow letterforms only · one grotesque, capitals, extreme size · destination stacking, via-points in smaller line
